caption: This drawing is composed in reddish-brown ink on a light beige background fabric. It features an elaborate square border with floral and scroll designs. In the center is a large framed rectangle depicting a man in military uniform with a feathered hat riding a galloping horse and holding a sword aloft. Directly below this central image is a round medallion with a building and the text “WILLIAM HENRY HARRISON.” Above the main image is a vignette showing a scene with a building, agricultural tools, and a banner. Flanking the central panel on each side are two vertically stacked circular vignettes, making a total of eight. The vignettes depict various scenes including groups of people gathered indoors, people engaged in discussions, soldiers in action, and a single standing man in a hat and uniform. The entire composition is symmetrical, with the intricate border enclosing the inner drawings and the surrounding scenes arranged evenly on both sides of the central figure on horseback.
title: Event Handkerchief
